subject.title: California — Proposition 1 (Authorizes Bonds for Housing Affordability Programs)

positions.statement: "Proposition 1" … Position: "OPPOSE" … Reason: "California is already paying off billions in bond debt, all at a cost to the general fund to service the debt payments. While a critical need, the funding for farmworker housing is not enough to make this a worthy effort."

subject.title: California — Proposition 2 (Increases State's Rainy Day Fund)

positions.statement: "Proposition 2" … Position: "NO POSITION" … Reason: "California Farm Bureau does not have policy on this topic."

subject.title: California — Proposition 3 (Provides Permanent Funding for Schools and Health Care by Extending Existing Tax on High Incomes)

positions.statement: "Proposition 3" … Position: "OPPOSE" … Reason: "California Farm Bureau opposes income tax increases."

subject.title: California — Proposition 4 (Repeals Prohibition Against Public Funding of Election Campaigns)

positions.statement: "Proposition 4" … Position: "OPPOSE" … Reason: "Funding for this program would come from the general fund. It is an unwise use of revenue given our budget situation."

subject.title: California — Proposition 5 (Changes Recall Election Process for Statewide Officers)

positions.statement: "Proposition 5" … Position: "NO POSITION" … Reason: "California Farm Bureau does not have policy on this topic."

subject.title: California — Proposition 37 (Creates Loan Program for Middle-Income Buyers of Qualified New Homes)

positions.statement: "Proposition 37" … Position: "NO POSITION" … Reason: "A self-funded revenue bond differentiates itself from a general obligation bond. Because this bond is self-funded, California Farm Bureau has no position on it."

subject.title: California — Proposition 38 (Authorizes Bonds for Immunology Medical Research)

positions.statement: "Proposition 38" … Position: "OPPOSE" … Reason: "Shifting government program costs from general tax revenues to additional public indebtedness through bond issuance to mitigate budget shortfalls is bad fiscal policy."

subject.title: California — Proposition 39 (Prohibits Citizens from Voting Unless They Present Government-Issued Identification)

positions.statement: "Proposition 39" … Position: "SUPPORT" … Reason: "Policy supports safe and secure elections."

subject.title: California — Proposition 40 (Imposes One-Time Tax on Certain Taxpayers)

positions.statement: "Proposition 40" … Position: "OPPOSE" … Reason: "California Farm Bureau opposes income tax increases."

subject.title: California — Proposition 41 (Prohibits New State Taxes That Exclude Revenues from State Spending Limit. Requires Audits for New State Special Taxes)

positions.statement: "Proposition 41" … Position: "SUPPORT" … Reason: "Fiscal responsibility and transparency is critical with taxpayer money."

subject.title: California — Proposition 42 (Prohibits New State Personal Property Taxes and Certain Retroactive State Taxes)

positions.statement: "Proposition 42" … Position: "SUPPORT" … Reason: "It is already expensive to live in California. There should not be another tax burden that will impact all Californians."

subject.title: California — Proposition 43 (Limits Voters' Ability to Raise Revenues for Local Government Services)

positions.statement: "Proposition 43" … Position: "SUPPORT" … Reason: "Restores two-thirds vote on local special taxes, which must be protected."

subject.title: California — Proposition 44 (Requires Community Health Clinics Spend 90% Of Revenue on Program Services)

positions.statement: "Proposition 44" … Position: "NO POSITION" … Reason: "California Farm Bureau does not have policy on this topic."
